name: morikeli/smart-scheduler
description: This is a django web app that allows lecturers to schedule lectures. The app notifies students about the scheduled class depending on the lecture's recurrence pattern.
score_rationale: Focused lecture scheduling and student notification makes it a direct classroom scheduling repo.
category: Classroom Management, Device Supervision, Screen Monitoring & Scheduling
